message: 忘れられた戦場

name: Azel
message: 「Guh... What is this. What is this pain...」

name: Azel
message: 「Could it really be that man--the presence of those people--affecting me...」

name: Azel
message: 「I don't understand... Why is my soul rejecting my own will...」

name: Azel
message: 「Any longer... I cannot acknowledge that existence...」

name: Azel
message: 「O Lord... I am not afraid...」

name: Virus
message: 「So in the end, you're no different from any other angel」

name: Virus
message: 「Clinging to the heavens and begging for salvation--that is the very picture of one」

name: Azel
message: 「Do not spout such foolishness, demon」

name: Virus
message: 「You already know the magic circle was destroyed, don't you」

name: Azel
message: 「...I know」

name: Virus
message: 「And yet you claim you can still achieve what you desire?」

name: Azel
message: 「I will accomplish it even on my own」

name: Virus
message: 「Is that so」

name: Virus
message: 「I simply want to meet the Demon King who is said to appear, lured by Re-Crea. That is all」

name: Azel
message: 「You must have already narrowed down who it is. Were you not satisfied with that」

name: Virus
message: 「What I seek is the true Demon King」

name: Virus
message: 「The time is not yet ripe. Naturally, neither am I satisfied」

name: Azel
message: 「And yet, Virus. Would you still get in my way just to satisfy your own desires?」

name: Virus
message: 「Listen, Azel. So long as we both achieve our goals, all is well. I have no intention of getting in your way」

name: Virus
message: 「You wish to bring about the largest Re―Crea in history―」

name: Virus
message: 「And I wish to challenge the Demon King said to boast supreme strength born from Re-Crea. There should be no mistake about that」

name: Azel
message: 「What a foolish wish. To put fighting above living itself」

name: Virus
message: 「Hahahaha, look who's talking, coming from the one trying to pass judgment on the world! You're going to lecture me on life?」

name: Virus
message: 「Those foolish feelings of yours are the very thing tormenting you」

name: Azel
message: 「What did you say...?」

name: Virus
message: 「And yet, why are you targeting the Demon Lord」

name: Virus
message: 「The Demon Lord's opponent is me」

name: Azel
message: 「Any existence that obstructs my goal must be eliminated」

name: Virus
message: 「So the contract is void, then. In that case, the answer is dead simple」

name: Azel
message: 「Did you actually think you could negotiate with me as an equal?」

name: Virus
message: 「So the answer you arrived at is brute force, huh. Pretty graceless behavior for an angel」

name: Virus
message: 「Still, I don't hate it. In fact, I'm thrilled to get to fight someone strong!」
